FRAME FIX IS CORRECT AND NECESSARY: 'Không tên …' negated a bare noun with no predicate, which vi does not licence; 'không có … nào' is the standard negative-existential frame and 'nào' is its negative-polarity item. Before the edit the first three words read as a truncated 'không tên' ('no name') and the sentence had to be re-parsed; with 'có' the frame closes and the phrase weight (~11 syllables in the quantified NP) no longer outruns it. This matches how the language is written elsewhere in this catalogue: a sweep of every vi catalogue value carrying the 'Không … nào' frame found the 'có' form throughout (ui.agents.pages.empty.search 'Không có kết quả nào khớp…', ui.agents.skills.empty.search 'Không có kỹ năng nào khớp…', ui.hub.teams.public.search_miss 'Không có nhóm nào…', ui.teamBridge.members.no_matches 'Không có người hoặc tác nhân nào…'), and the corrected string now sits in that family instead of being the lone clipped member.

SIBLING PARALLELISM RESTORED, NOT BROKEN: all four pages empty-state bodies/titles now carry a 'có'/'chưa có'/'chưa' frame — empty.org.title 'chưa có', empty.category.body 'Chưa có gì', empty.search.title 'Không có', empty.search.body 'Không có', empty.public.body 'Chưa ai'. Before the edit this body was the only one without it. Cross-namespace, the pages search miss ('Không có tên hay mô tả tác nhân nào chứa nội dung đó') and the teams search miss ('Không có nhóm nào trên trang này khớp với “{query}”') now share the same 'Không có … nào khớp/chứa …' shape. The two untouched pages/teams pairs that matter (empty.org.body vs teams org.empty, and clear.search vs the teams search affordance) are unchanged by this commit.

MEANING AGAINST ENGLISH: source 'No agent's name or description carries that. Clear it to see the whole hub.' The vi sentence keeps both required facts from the sidecar: the coverage ('tên hay mô tả tác nhân' = the agent's name or description) and the action, using the same noun as clear.search ('Xóa tìm kiếm', value of ui.hub.pages.clear.search). The sidecar's warning against the category miss's 'carries that filter' phrasing does not bite in vi: the vi category body is 'Chưa có gì trong danh mục này' and the vi search body uses 'chứa nội dung đó' ('contains that content'), which is neutral in Vietnamese and does not reproduce the English oddity of something 'carrying' a typed query.

WHOLE STRING AFTER THE EDIT: the second sentence is untouched and still reads naturally ('Hãy xóa tìm kiếm để xem toàn bộ trung tâm.'), the imperative tone and terminal full stop match the sidecar's 'plain two-sentence explanation, imperative second sentence', and 'trung tâm' for the hub is the settled noun in this file (also in empty.category.body). Length 96 chars / 23 words, unwrapped in a max-w-md paragraph with the clear button beneath, so the extra 3 characters cannot change layout behaviour.

CHARACTER HYGIENE: value is NFC (no decomposed combining sequences), contains no format (Cf) characters, no bidi control, no NBSP or other odd space, no leading/trailing or double space, ASCII digits absent, ASCII '...' absent (a full stop is used), and the sentence ends with a period. findings.summary: Residual two-word ambiguity, pre-existing word order, not introduced or worsened by this correction: 'tên hay mô tả tác nhân' can momentarily parse as 'tên hay' ('a good name', hay as adjective) before 'mô tả tác nhân' forces the coordination reading (hay = 'or'). The 'nào' resolves it on the second pass, so no meaning is lost and no reader is left in a wrong reading; it is materially shallower than the clipped-'có' garden path this round confirms fixed. Suggested one-line fix if a later copy pass touches the line: 'Không có tên tác nhân hay mô tả nào chứa nội dung đó.' keeps 'tên tác nhân' together and removes the 'good name' reading.
